title: Not by Wishes: Justice, Peace, and Faith

paragraphs.text: Paradise does not come by wishes. Whoever does wrong will be paid for it. Any believer who does good enters Paradise, man or woman. The best religion is to submit to Allah and do good. Allah took Abraham as a close friend.
Allah gives rulings about women and orphan girls. A wife and husband may make peace. Peace is best. You cannot be fully equal between wives. But do not leave one hanging.
Everything in the heavens and earth belongs to Allah. He needs nothing and is Praiseworthy. He could replace you with other people.

Stand firm for justice, even against yourselves or parents. Be just to rich and poor. Believe in Allah, His Messenger, and His books. Some believe, then disbelieve again and again. Hypocrites will have a painful punishment. They seek honor from disbelievers. But all honor belongs to Allah.
